title: Panama City Beach Police Department
key_finding: The official city police page lists a live Panama City Beach Police Department with non-emergency number, Police Chief Eusebio Talamantez Jr, Deputy Chief John Deegins, and multiple division commanders.

title: Contact Us
key_finding: The official contact page lists Panama City Beach Police Department at 17115 Panama City Beach Parkway with non-emergency and administration phone numbers plus admin@pcbfl.gov.

title: County and Municipal Offense Report 2020A
key_finding: FDLE's 2020 county-and-municipal offense report lists Panama City Beach Police Department with population 13,691 and total index crime 887.

title: County and Municipal Offense Report 2021A workbook
key_finding: FDLE's 2021 Bay County county-and-municipal workbook lists Bay County Sheriff's Office and Panama City Beach Police Department as separate rows, and gives Panama City Beach population 18,783 and total index crime 833.

title: FIBRS Offense Detail 2021-2025 Q3 workbook
key_finding: Inspection of the official FDLE FIBRS workbook found no Panama City Beach Police Department or FL0030600 row on the 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, or 2025 Q3 sheets.

title: agency_rosters_2024.csv
publisher: FBI Crime Data Explorer via official API pull cached in repo
key_finding: The official FBI CDE 2024 roster snapshot lists FL0030600 as Panama City Beach Police Department, agency type City, with is_nibrs false and no nibrs_start_date.

title: ori_source_validation_2024.csv
publisher: CrimeRisk repo using official FBI CDE roster inputs
key_finding: The validation artifact flags FL0030600 as present_but_no_2024_observation with official_is_nibrs false and mismatch_reason no_2024_observation.

title: agency_to_jurisdiction_crosswalk.parquet
key_finding: FL0030600 routes exclusively to 12:municipal:place:1254725 Panama City Beach city.

title: jurisdiction_master.csv
key_finding: Panama City Beach city is a municipal place target with agency_count 1 and is_contracted_place set to False.

title: agency_master.parquet
key_finding: agency_master classifies FL0030600 as a local police department and flags SRS and NIBRS source presence through 2024 even though the official FBI roster marks the agency non-NIBRS.

title: agency_year_observations.parquet
key_finding: Repo observations carry substantive annual Panama City Beach counts through 2020, then only zero-valued SRS annual rows in 2021-2024 and no NIBRS observations.

title: jurisdiction_controls_2024.parquet
key_finding: All 2024 Panama City Beach offense controls are filled from history because preferred reported support is zero and the row is treated as structurally missing or unreliable.

title: municipal_target_review_queue.csv
key_finding: Panama City Beach is queued in high_impact_full_fill_place with suspect_reason full_fill_no_reported_support, total_fill_count 969.0, and total_reported_count 0.0.

title: fbi_cde_source_review_queue.csv
key_finding: The repo's FBI/CDE review queue separately flags FL0030600 as present_but_no_2024_observation with official_is_nibrs false.
